title: Build Runner v3.6 robustly
description: Robust side-by-side build of Runner v3.6 from the verified v3.5 source. Uses line-array edits instead of here-strings. Persists terminal status for SUCCESS/FAILED_BACKUP/FAILED_SCRIPT/FAILED_TEST and records REJECTED tasks so identical ID+SHA is not re-run. Active v3.5 process is not replaced or restarted.
